caption: The drawing features a central human figure standing atop a dark, bestial creature. The human figure wears a short red skirt, a green tunic with red sleeve-cuffs, red sandals with green decorations, a wide brown strap across the chest, and a large, ornate hat that is gray with gold trim and a red jewel. The figure holds a long, curved sword upright in their right hand, while their left hand is raised, palm outward. The creature beneath the figure is dark blue or black, with clawed limbs, a tail, pointed ears, and red eyes, positioned lying on its back as if subdued. Both figures stand on a rectangular base that is white with black outlining, and the base contains the text "SAN. MIGUEL" in capital letters, flanked by decorative scrollwork on each side. The composition uses bold lines and flat areas of color against a light tan background.
title: Plate 38: St. Michael: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
